{{Top|leg}}
'''Team 1044''' was a team a researchers that was sent by the [[Restimar Mining Corporation]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as part of [[Operation Cracked Crystal]]. During the operation, the team's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] guide [[C4K0]] became damaged as a result of an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] and began to attack the researchers, who sent out an emergencry transmission requesting that they be evacuated.
